mapper.sql: p.post_id AS postId, p.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, p.content AS content, p.language AS language, p.content_version AS contentVersion, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM community_posts p INNER JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.member_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_posts ( member_id, content, language, content_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{content}, #{language}, 1, NOW(), NOW() )
INSERT INTO community_post_images ( post_id, image_url, display_order, created_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{imageUrl}, #{displayOrder}, NOW() )
